It does not alter Opportunity, Forward Outlook, Buy Urgency, suggested tranche or recommendation. Shadow outcomes are evaluated independently at 1/5/10 trading-day horizons, and Thin/Unavailable coverage cannot become a directional call.
important_note: This model ranks the attractiveness of converting SGD into foreign currency. It is a decision-support tool, not a guarantee of future exchange-rate direction.
